mapper.sql: id, visitor_name, phone, visit_owner_id, visit_owner, house_no, visit_reason, car_plate, visit_time, leave_time, status, register

where.if: AND (visitor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR visit_owner LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR car_plate LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR house_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visitor (visitor_name, phone, visit_owner_id, visit_owner, house_no, visit_reason, car_plate, visit_time, leave_time, status, register) VALUES (#{visitorName}, #{phone}, #{visitOwnerId}, #{visitOwner}, #{houseNo}, #{visitReason}, #{carPlate}, IFNULL(#{visitTime}, NOW()), #{leaveTime}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'IN'), #{register})
